key_info_llm.csv.llm_value: LIBOR for the relevant Interest Period (1, 3, or 6 months) plus 1.25% Margin per annum, computed on actual days elapsed and a 360-day year
key_info_llm.csv.llm_evidence_quote: Each Advance shall bear interest at the Applicable Rate which shall be the rate per annum which is equal to the aggregate of (a) LIBOR for the relevant Interest Period plus (b) the Margin.
key_info_llm.csv.note: Section 1.1 defines Margin as 1.25% per annum; Section 6.5 specifies actual/360 calculation.

key_info_llm.csv.llm_evidence_quote: 13.1 Commitment Fee. The Borrower shall pay to the Administrative Agent on behalf of the Lenders a fee in the amount of (i) .25% per annum on the available but undrawn amount of the Credit Facility from the date hereof through the initial Drawdown Date and (ii) .50% per annum thereafter, in each case quarterly in arrears from the date hereof.
key_info_llm.csv.note: Sections 13.2-13.4 specify the $10,000 annual Agency Fee, 0.50% Arrangement Fee, and additional unattached Fee Letter fees.

key_info_llm.csv.llm_evidence_quote: interest thereafter until paid at a rate per annum of two percent (2%) over the Applicable Rate in effect with respect to such payment at the time of such default (the "Default Rate").
key_info_llm.csv.note: Applies to any amounts due under this Agreement not paid when due (whether by acceleration or otherwise).

key_info_llm.csv.llm_value: Optional prepayment on last day of an Interest Period upon 5 Banking Days' written notice, without penalty (except LIBOR funding breakage costs and accrued interest under Section 5.4), in minimums of $1,000,000 plus $1,000,000 multiples (or full Advance) with reborrowing permitted; permanent Facility reductions allowed in >= $2,500,000 multiples; mandatory prepayments under Sections 9.3/9.4
key_info_llm.csv.llm_evidence_quote: 5.2 Prepayment; Reborrowing. The Borrower may prepay, upon five (5) Banking Days written notice, any outstanding Advance or any portion thereof, without penalty, provided that such prepayment is made on the last day of the Interest Period of such Advance. Each prepayment shall be in a minimum amount of One Million Dollars ($1,000,000) plus any One Million Dollar ($1,000,000) multiples thereof or the full amount of the Advance.
